regression.description: Redundant __syncthreads() calls added throughout the kernel

locations.issue: Unnecessary __syncthreads() after initial load into shared memory
Double __syncthreads() in each reduction loop iteration

regression.plausible_reasoning: Developer might think extra synchronization ensures correctness and prevents race conditions

changes: Remove redundant __syncthreads() after load (implicit barrier already exists)
Keep only one __syncthreads() per reduction iteration
optimization.reasoning: Each unnecessary sync adds ~20-30 cycles latency, accumulating across iterations

verification.correctness: Result must match CPU reference within EPSILON (1e-5)
verification.performance: Optimized version should be 4-7x faster than baseline
